text.ci.yml: Runs the install, typecheck, lint and unit tests, the headless Playwright e2e suites and a unit-test coverage run that is uploaded as an artifact, plus builds and packaging on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows runners, where the Ubuntu leg also zips the Linux package and checks what is in it, on every push and pull request with SHA-pinned actions
text.codeql.yml: Scans the JavaScript and TypeScript sources with CodeQL on pushes to main, on pull requests and weekly, with read-only contents access, write access to security events only and SHA-pinned actions
text.deploy-docs.yml: Builds the documentation site on every change to its sources and on pull requests, and publishes it to GitHub Pages from main with SHA-pinned actions, defaulting the site URL to docs.thelantern.dev
text.release.yml: Builds the macOS, Windows and Linux packages when a v* tag is pushed or a tag is chosen by hand, signing and notarizing the macOS app in the protected release environment only from a v* tag and checking the Linux zip before it goes up, and attaches them, plus a copy of the macOS zip named for Apple silicon so the updater finds it and a SHA256SUMS file listing every zip, to that tag's GitHub Release, which is created with generated notes when missing
